title: Googlekeep2
details: Googlekeep2 allows users to add text notes. You can edit and delete these notes. It has login and signup functionality.

title: Daily Dose (News app)
details: Daily Dose shows the top news headlines of the day in different fields, you can learn more about a specific article by clicking on the read more button.

title: Teachers Toolkit
details: With this app, students can access simple and easy notes made by their teachers. I have added several options to pick from. check it out.

title: Drum Kit
details: The drum kit lets you make various cool sounds simply by clicking the buttons.

title: To Do List
details: The Todo list lets you add tasks you need to complete. and it is easy to use.
